why.B2.4: Highly specific findings of hyperreflective tissues and dendritic vascular-like structures, along with pyramid-shaped proliferations, strongly support Chronic Progressive Ocular Vascular Proliferation Syndrome with Neovascularization.
why.B3.1: Similar findings of hyperreflective tissues and dendritic vascular-like structures, although less specific, also support Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy, but with less distinctive features than B2.4.
why.B4.1: The evidence supporting Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy is the least specific among the options, with general findings of hyperreflective tissues and neovascularization that could apply to multiple conditions, and lacks distinctive features that would elevate it above other diagnoses.
